tools.description: Additively synchronize schematic components, nets and ratlines into a PCB. Distances are mm, regardless of the document Units attribute. Input schema: diptrace://schemas/tool-inputs. dry_run=true only previews; write with dry_run=false after reviewing it, passing its expected_sha256.
tools.name: sync_schematic_to_pcb

tools.description: Remove selected components from groups and prune only empty groups. Distances are mm, regardless of the document Units attribute. Input schema: diptrace://schemas/tool-inputs. dry_run=true only previews; write with dry_run=false after reviewing it, passing its expected_sha256.
tools.name: ungroup_components

tools.description:
Validate distinct allowed-root evidence roles and exact SHA bindings without writing.

The bounded result is always authority=user_supplied and grants_high_trust=false.

EvidenceRoleInput.description: One SHA-bound file role in operator-supplied evidence.

path.description: Existing evidence file inside an allowed root.

sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256 of the exact evidence file bytes.

RoundtripEvidenceInput.description: Distinct source, saved, and optional re-export evidence roles.

reexport.description: Optional independent re-export used for structural semantic comparison. Omit it for an open/save-only observation.

saved.description: File saved by DipTrace after opening the source.

source.description: File exported before the operator's DipTrace open/save action.
